findings: Final node-only assertions do not prove stall IOException or that the other error was collected before stall; socket fixture lacks controlled synchronization and bounded observation of prerequisites.

The test does not exercise retries, following DBQ/commit or late callbacks; HashMap traversal order is uncontrolled. The existing Linux gate requests runtime fail-before and a separate ordering probe, but a probe is not a permanent regression if a defect is established.
Value equality and property restoration in the fork follow-up are sound by inspection. No Gradle runs on Windows; no behavioral proof claimed.
